segments.name: Insurance brokerage
segments.description: Provides insurance brokerage and technology services in China, mainly insurance transaction services and SaaS.
segments.evidence: The Group manages its operations as a single 1 segment engaged in providing insurance brokerage and technology services in China.

revenueModel.text: Insurance carriers and intermediaries pay service fees for facilitating insurance sales, plus fees for SaaS and technical services.
revenueModel.evidence: which adversely affected the service fees that we received from facilitating the sale of commercial auto insurance through our Easy-Insur since October 2020

changes.text: In 2024 the company ceased offering its Insurance Marketplace business as a strategic adjustment.
changes.evidence: As a result, insurance carriers received lower premiums from selling commercial auto insurance, which adversely affected the service fees that we received from facilitating the sale of commercial auto insurance through our Easy-Insur since October 2020, and through Insurance Marketplace between October 2020 and April 2024, when we ceased to offer Insurance Marketplace due to strategic adjustment of our business.
